name: Pour the Tea
source: In the middle of the woods, a mysterious tea party is taking place. You don't know your guests, or why you're even here, but one thing is certain: you won't make any progress until you pour the tea.
translation: 树林中央，一场神秘的茶会正在举行。你不认识你的客人，也不知道你为什么在这里，但有一件事是肯定的：除非你倒茶，否则你不会取得任何进展。
